name: Complete partial code for interactive web applications
description: Users provided partial source code for web applications, such as multiplayer chat servers and music sequencers, and requested the assistant to complete the missing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript sections to make the interfaces functional. While most requests focused on implementing real-time chat logic, some involved specific UI components or other web tools.
